Wood.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or an axe. The cheapest resource--fast to produce, and used as a basic building block to craft various tools and upgrades. Also used as consumable fuel for mining drills. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 1 bit per wood.

Stone.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or a quarry. An easy-to-produce resource used as a building block for crafting various tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 2 bits per stone.

Iron.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or a mining drill. Slightly more expensive to produce than wood or stone, and used as an ingredient into higher-level tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 5 bits per iron.

Coal.summary: Used as fuel for higher level production facilities.
Coal.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a mining drill. Slightly more expensive to produce than wood or stone, and used as a fuel for operating higher level production facilities.

Geode.summary: Crack this open to reveal a gem.
Geode.description: Requires a moderate amount of proof-of-work to produce, as well as a mining drill. Crack it open to obtain a gem.

Quartz.description: Produced by cracking open a Geode. Used to create or upgrade higher-level production facilities. Can be converted into 100 bits (added to a bucket).

Amethyst.description: Produced by cracking open a Geode. Can be converted into 2,000 bits (added to a bucket).

Sapphire.description: Produced by cracking open a Geode. Can be converted into 40,000 bits (added to a bucket).

Emerald.description: Produced by cracking open a Geode. Can be converted into 800,000 bits (added to a bucket).

Ruby.description: Produced by cracking open a Geode. Can be converted into 16,000,000 bits (added to a bucket).

Diamond.description: Produced by cracking open a Geode. Can be converted into 320,000,000 bits (added to a bucket).

Stick.description: Produced from wood. Used for crafting axes.

BucketOfWood.description: Holds any amount of wood. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 wood at a time to the bucket. You can remove wood from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfStone.description: Holds any amount of stone. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 stone at a time to the bucket. You can remove stone from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfIron.description: Holds any amount of iron. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 iron at a time to the bucket. You can remove iron from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfBits.description: Holds any amount of bits. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 bits at a time to the bucket. You can remove bits from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfCoal.description: Holds any amount of coal. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 coal at a time to the bucket. You can remove coal from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfQuartz.description: Holds any amount of quartz. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 quartz at a time to the bucket. You can remove quartz from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BarrelOfOil.summary: Holds a variable quantity of oil.
BarrelOfOil.description: Holds any amount of oil. Filled from operating a pumpjack. Used as an ingredient for higher-level materials and consumables.

Pocketknife.summary: A basic tool for gathering wood, stone, and iron.
Pocketknife.description: A basic tool that allows you to gather wood, stone, and iron. Gathers resources very slowly. Infinite durability.

WoodAxe.summary: A basic axe for chopping wood.
WoodAxe.description: Chops 2 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Can be upgraded to a stone axe.

StoneAxe.summary: A solid axe for chopping wood.
StoneAxe.description: Chops 3 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Made by upgrading a wood axe with 1 stone. Can be upgraded to an iron axe.

IronAxe.summary: A powerful axe for chopping wood.
IronAxe.description: Chops 4 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Made by upgrading a stone axe with 1 iron.

Quarry.description: Requires wood and stone to build or upgrade: 20 wood and 10 stone for a level 1 quarry, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Mines 2 stone per action at level 1, 3 stone per action at level 2, etc.

MiningDrill.description: Requires wood, stone, and iron to build or upgrade: 10 wood, 50 stone, and 5 iron for a level 1 mining drill, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Mines 2 iron per action at level 1, 3 iron per action at level 2, etc. Consumes 5 wood per mining action.

Pumpjack.description: Requires stone, iron, and quartz to build or upgrade: 50 stone, 100 iron, and 1 quartz for a level 1 pumpjack, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Requires 5 coal and a barrel to begin pumping oil. Can pump for any number of steps; each step takes a moderate amount of non-parallelizable cryptographic work, though the 5 coal cost of starting the pump is fixed. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step.

Bit.description: Can be produced from wood, stone, or iron at a rate of 1 bit per wood, 2 bits per stone, or 5 bits per iron. Can also be produced from gems.

CraftPocketknife.summary: Create a pocketknife. Requires no inputs.
CraftPocketknife.description: Create a pocketknife, an infinite-durability tool used for gathering wood, stone, and iron.

GatherWood.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 wood. (~15 seconds)
GatherWood.description: Produce 1 wood using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~15 seconds on a modern CPU.

GatherStone.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 stone. (~30 seconds)
GatherStone.description: Produce 1 stone using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

GatherIron.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 iron. (~60 seconds)
GatherIron.description: Produce 1 iron using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

CraftBucketOfWood.summary: Make an empty bucket for wood from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfWood.description: A bucket holds a stack of wood. You can add and remove wood to it via the appropriate actions.

CraftBucketOfStone.summary: Make an empty bucket for stone from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfStone.description: A bucket holds a stack of stone. You can add and remove stone to it via the appropriate actions.

CraftBucketOfIron.summary: Make an empty bucket for iron from 1 iron.

CraftBucketOfQuartz.summary: Make an empty bucket for quartz from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfQuartz.description: A bucket holds a stack of quartz. You can add and remove quartz to it via the appropriate actions.

CraftBarrelOfOil.summary: Craft an empty barrel for holding oil, from 5 iron.
CraftBarrelOfOil.description: A barrel holds a variable quantity of oil. You can pump oil into the barrel using a pumpjack.

CraftWoodAxe.summary: Make a wooden axe from 2 sticks and 1 wood.
CraftWoodAxe.description: Consumes 2 sticks and 1 wood to create a wooden axe, which chops wood twice as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

CraftStoneAxe.summary: Upgrade a wooden axe to a stone axe using 1 stone.
CraftStoneAxe.description: Consumes a wooden axe and 1 stone to create a stone axe, which chops wood three times as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

CraftIronAxe.summary: Upgrade a stone axe to an iron axe using 1 iron.
CraftIronAxe.description: Consumes a stone axe and 1 iron to create an iron axe, which chops wood four times as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

BuildQuarry.summary: Build a level 1 quarry using 20 wood and 10 stone.
BuildQuarry.description: A level 1 quarry mines stone twice as fast as a pocketknife. Quarries have infinite durability, and can be upgraded to produce stone even faster.

BuildMiningDrill.summary: Build a level 1 mining drill using 10 wood, 50 stone, and 5 iron.
BuildMiningDrill.description: A level 1 mining drill mines iron twice as fast as a pocketknife. Mining drills have infinite durability, and can be upgraded to produce iron even faster.

BuildPumpjack.summary: Build a level 1 pumpjack using a bucket of 50 stone, a bucket of 100 iron, and 1 quartz.
BuildPumpjack.description: A pumpjack allows you to produce oil. Pumping oil requires a pumpjack, a barrel for holding the oil, and 5 coal.

LevelUpQuarry1.summary: Upgrades a level 1 quarry to level 2.
LevelUpQuarry1.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 1. Spends a bucket holding at least 40 wood and a bucket holding at least 20 stone. A level 2 quarry mines stone 3 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill1.summary: Upgrades a level 1 mining drill to level 2.
LevelUpMiningDrill1.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 1. Spends buckets holding at least 20 wood, 100 stone, and 10 iron. A level 2 mining drill mines iron 3 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack1.summary: Upgrade a level 1 pumpjack to level 2.
LevelUpPumpjack1.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 1. Spends a bucket holding at least 100 stone, a bucket holding at least 200 iron, and a bucket holding at least 2 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry2.summary: Upgrades a level 2 quarry to level 3.
LevelUpQuarry2.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 2. Spends a bucket holding at least 80 wood and a bucket holding at least 40 stone. A level 3 quarry mines stone 4 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill2.summary: Upgrades a level 2 mining drill to level 3.
LevelUpMiningDrill2.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 2. Spends buckets holding at least 40 wood, 200 stone, and 20 iron. A level 3 mining drill mines iron 4 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack2.summary: Upgrade a level 2 pumpjack to level 3.
LevelUpPumpjack2.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 2. Spends a bucket holding at least 200 stone, a bucket holding at least 400 iron, and a bucket holding at least 4 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry3.summary: Upgrades a level 3 quarry to level 4.
LevelUpQuarry3.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 3. Spends a bucket holding at least 160 wood and a bucket holding at least 80 stone. A level 4 quarry mines stone 5 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill3.summary: Upgrades a level 3 mining drill to level 4.
LevelUpMiningDrill3.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 3. Spends buckets holding at least 80 wood, 400 stone, and 40 iron. A level 4 mining drill mines iron 5 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack3.summary: Upgrade a level 3 pumpjack to level 4.
LevelUpPumpjack3.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 3. Spends a bucket holding at least 400 stone, a bucket holding at least 800 iron, and a bucket holding at least 8 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry4.summary: Upgrades a level 4 quarry to level 5.

LevelUpMiningDrill4.summary: Upgrades a level 4 mining drill to level 5.
LevelUpMiningDrill4.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 4. Spends buckets holding at least 160 wood, 800 stone, and 80 iron. A level 5 mining drill mines iron 6 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack4.summary: Upgrade a level 4 pumpjack to level 5.
LevelUpPumpjack4.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 4. Spends a bucket holding at least 800 stone, a bucket holding at least 1600 iron, and a bucket holding at least 16 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry5.summary: Upgrades a level 5 quarry to level 6.
LevelUpQuarry5.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 5. Spends a bucket holding at least 640 wood and a bucket holding at least 320 stone. A level 6 quarry mines stone 7 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill5.summary: Upgrades a level 5 mining drill to level 6.
LevelUpMiningDrill5.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 5. Spends buckets holding at least 320 wood, 1600 stone, and 160 iron. A level 6 mining drill mines iron 7 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack5.summary: Upgrade a level 5 pumpjack to level 6.
LevelUpPumpjack5.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 5. Spends a bucket holding at least 1600 stone, a bucket holding at least 3200 iron, and a bucket holding at least 32 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry6.summary: Upgrades a level 6 quarry to level 7.
LevelUpQuarry6.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 6. Spends a bucket holding at least 1280 wood and a bucket holding at least 640 stone. A level 7 quarry mines stone 8 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill6.summary: Upgrades a level 6 mining drill to level 7.
LevelUpMiningDrill6.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 6. Spends buckets holding at least 640 wood, 3200 stone, and 320 iron. A level 7 mining drill mines iron 8 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack6.summary: Upgrade a level 6 pumpjack to level 7.

LevelUpQuarry7.summary: Upgrades a level 7 quarry to level 8.
LevelUpQuarry7.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 7. Spends a bucket holding at least 2560 wood and a bucket holding at least 1280 stone. A level 8 quarry mines stone 9 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill7.summary: Upgrades a level 7 mining drill to level 8.
LevelUpMiningDrill7.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 7. Spends buckets holding at least 1280 wood, 6400 stone, and 640 iron. A level 8 mining drill mines iron 9 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack7.summary: Upgrade a level 7 pumpjack to level 8.
LevelUpPumpjack7.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 7. Spends a bucket holding at least 6400 stone, a bucket holding at least 12800 iron, and a bucket holding at least 128 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry8.summary: Upgrades a level 8 quarry to level 9.
LevelUpQuarry8.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 8. Spends a bucket holding at least 5120 wood and a bucket holding at least 2560 stone. A level 9 quarry mines stone 10 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill8.summary: Upgrades a level 8 mining drill to level 9.
LevelUpMiningDrill8.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 8. Spends buckets holding at least 2560 wood, 12800 stone, and 1280 iron. A level 9 mining drill mines iron 10 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack8.summary: Upgrade a level 8 pumpjack to level 9.
LevelUpPumpjack8.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 8. Spends a bucket holding at least 12800 stone, a bucket holding at least 25600 iron, and a bucket holding at least 256 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

LevelUpQuarry9.summary: Upgrades a level 9 quarry to level 10.
LevelUpQuarry9.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 9. Spends a bucket holding at least 10240 wood and a bucket holding at least 5120 stone. A level 10 quarry mines stone 11 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill9.summary: Upgrades a level 9 mining drill to level 10.
LevelUpMiningDrill9.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 9. Spends buckets holding at least 5120 wood, 25600 stone, and 2560 iron. A level 10 mining drill mines iron 11 times as fast as a pocketknife. Higher level mining drills also mine more coal per use, and find geodes faster.

LevelUpPumpjack9.summary: Upgrade a level 9 pumpjack to level 10.
LevelUpPumpjack9.description: Only works on a pumpjack at exactly level 9. Spends a bucket holding at least 25600 stone, a bucket holding at least 51200 iron, and a bucket holding at least 512 quartz. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step they are run.

PumpOil.summary: Use a pumpjack to pump oil into an oil barrel. Consumes 5 coal.
PumpOil.description: Produce a variable amount of oil using a pumpjack. Requires 5 coal and a barrel for the oil to be pumped into. You can specify the number of steps you'd like to operate the pumpjack for: each step requires performing serial (non-parallelizable) cryptographic work (about 5 minutes per step on a typical laptop), though the 5 coal input cost is fixed. Higher level pumpjacks produce more oil per step.

MineGeode1.summary: Use a level 1 mining drill to mine a Geode.
MineGeode1.description: Produce a geode using a mining drill. Consumes 5 wood, and requires performing a moderate amount of proof-of-work hash mining. Higher level mining drills find geodes faster: at level N, finding a geode takes about 20 / N minutes on average. Once found, a geode can be cracked open to reveal either a quartz, an amethyst, a sapphire, a emerald, a ruby, or a diamond.
